data.summary: Shri Anindya Biswas has been appointed as a Non-Executive Government Nominee Director of the company effective 7th October, 2026. He succeeds Dr. K Rajalakshmi Menon, whose nomination was withdrawn by the Ministry of Defence.

people.name: Dr. K Rajalakshmi Menon
people.reason: Being nominee director, nomination was withdrawn by MoD

people.name: Shri Anindya Biswas
people.bio: He is renowned for his R&D efforts towards indigenous design, development and production of avionic sub-systems for indigenous missiles. He joined DRDO in 1992 and has contributed to several missile systems. He holds a graduation in Electronics and Telecommunications from Bengal Engineering College, Shibpur and an M. Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering from IIT Kharagpur.
